title: Famulor automation template listing
description: automations/<slug>/listing.json — how the template appears in the Automations template gallery. The workflow itself is automation.famulor-automation.json, exported from the app.

slug.description: Stable id. Equals the folder name. Never rename it after merge.

about.description: Short paragraph for the template page: when it runs and what it does.

setup_hint.description: What the user still picks or types after using the template, e.g. the assistant and the SMS sender.

connectors.description: Slugs of connectors in this repository that the template needs.
